name: UL2 20B
description:
Here is how to read the UL2 20B config.json. The architecture class is T5ForConditionalGeneration, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,096: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 32,128 × 4,096: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 16, so each head sees 256 dimensions (4,096 / 16). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 4096 / 16 = 256. 256 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 32: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

vocab_size is 32,128. 32,128 is divisible by 128. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

torch_dtype is float16.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/philschmid/flan-ul2-20b-fp16/blob/main/config.json.
